name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: The classic split-leaf statement plant. Grows fast in bright, indirect light.

name: Boston Fern
description: Soft, arching fronds that love humidity. Happiest in a bathroom or kitchen.

name: Snake Plant
description: Upright, striped leaves that tolerate low light and missed waterings.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: Broad, glossy leaves on a tall stem. Give it one bright spot and leave it there.

name: String of Pearls
description: Bead-like trailing stems made for hanging planters and high shelves.

name: Echeveria Rosette
description: A tight, blue-green rosette that needs sun and very little water.

name: Bunny Ear Cactus
description: Paddle-shaped pads with a cheerful look. Water about once every two weeks.

name: Lavender Graptoveria
description: A pastel purple succulent that holds its color best on a sunny sill.

name: Peace Lily
description: White blooms and deep green leaves. It droops to tell you when it is thirsty.

name: African Violet
description: Compact and fuzzy-leaved, with purple flowers most of the year.

name: Kalanchoe
description: Clusters of bright orange flowers on a sturdy, easy-care succulent.

name: Copper-Spout Watering Can
description: A one-liter can with a long, narrow spout that reaches under leaves.

name: Terracotta Pot Trio
description: Three breathable clay pots in small, medium and large, with drainage holes.

name: Fine Mist Spray Bottle
description: Raises humidity for ferns and tropicals with an even, gentle mist.

name: Aroid Potting Mix
description: A chunky, fast-draining blend of bark, perlite and coir for tropical plants.
